entities.name: Jiří Feureisl
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jiří Feureisl was a Czechoslovak football forward who played for Czechoslovakia in the 1958 FIFA World Cup, scoring a goal in the 6–1 win over Argentina., and the 1955–1960 Central European International Cup, which Czechoslovakia national team won, with him being his teams joint top scorer.
